action: No action needed for the public unless the court contacts you; if you are contacted as an affected data subject, follow its instructions and be wary of messages that claim to come from the court.
date_note: The court first announced the incident on 2026-11-13 and confirmed the leak of files on 2026-11-14.
exec: A state court confirmed leaked files after a cyber incident; its own review found judicial and administrative systems intact.
org: Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais (TJMG)
plain: The Minas Gerais state court says some files from a cyber incident were leaked online. It says its court and administrative systems were not compromised.

sources.name: TJMG: TJMG monitora desdobramentos de incidente de segurança cibernético (14/11/2026)

summary: The Minas Gerais court said on 14 November that some leaked files had been published after a cyber incident first reported on 13 November. It says analysis found no compromise of judicial or administrative systems. It reset at-risk credentials, is contacting affected people and has told the ANPD and police. The attacker and file contents are not stated.
title: Minas Gerais court confirms leaked files after cyber incident

validation.note: Primary source: the court's own statement of 14 November 2026. Media reports (Estadão, Band) were not opened.
